name: What are the first steps to building a custom tiny home?

step.name: Step 1: Property Assessment and Visioning — This is where we start with you. We'll look at your land, whether it’s in Vista, Encinitas, Spring Valley, or anywhere else in our service area, to understand its potential and any site-specific challenges. This initial assessment helps us see what’s feasible for your property. At the same time, we'll talk extensively about your vision: how you live, what you need, and what you dream for your compact space. This phase typically takes a few weeks, allowing for site visits and initial consultations.

step.name: Step 2: Custom Design and Blueprinting — Once we have a clear understanding of your property and your lifestyle, our designers get to work. This isn't about shrinking a traditional house; it's about smart, small-space-first design. We create efficient layouts, integrated storage, and flexible living areas tailored precisely to you. You'll be involved every step of the way, reviewing 3D designs and providing feedback. This design phase can take anywhere from 1-3 months, depending on the complexity and revisions.

step.name: Step 3: Permitting and Regulatory Navigation — With your custom design finalized, we move into the crucial permitting stage. This involves submitting plans to local city or county agencies for approval, ensuring everything meets building codes and zoning requirements. Because we have over a decade of experience working with San Diego's specific tiny home regulations, we can often streamline this process. This step can vary widely, from 2-6 months, depending on the municipality and project specifics.

step.name: Step 4: Construction and Craftsmanship — Once permits are in hand, the build begins! Our skilled team, known for high-quality, custom tiny homes, will bring your design to life. We focus on quality craftsmanship and efficient construction. You’ll see your home take shape, from the foundation to the finishing touches. This phase generally lasts 3-6 months, depending on the size and features of your home.

step.name: Step 5: Final Walkthrough and Move-In — The exciting conclusion! We’ll do a thorough final walkthrough together to ensure every detail is perfect and meets your expectations. Then, it’s time to get your keys and start enjoying your beautifully designed, high-functioning tiny home. This last step is quick, just a matter of days, before you begin your new chapter in intelligent living.
